title_en: Call for Applications: SNU Grand Quest Academy Junior Program 2027
summary: Undergraduate and master's students who wish to take part in the SNU Grand Quest Academy Junior Program 2027 must apply individually on the SNU Grand Quest website (grandquest.snu.ac.kr) by Thursday, 5 November 2026. Applicants must complete the application form and attach it on the website. Selected applicants will be contacted individually during the second week of November, and the program runs from 16 December 2026 to 24 March 2027.
applies_to: Voluntary; applies to those who wish to apply. Eligible: undergraduate students and master's students, including students on leave of absence; students in the integrated master's-doctoral program who are within their first four semesters; and students who have completed master's coursework (수료), provided no more than one semester has passed since completion. About 25 participants will be selected.

dates.what: Selection results, sent to each applicant individually
dates.when: During the second week of November (2026)

dates.what: Orientation (one day): preliminary exploration, for selected participants
Camp (three days, two nights): question inquiry, for selected participants
Connect session (one day): presentation of results, for selected participants

conditions: Students in the integrated master's-doctoral program are eligible only if they are within their first four semesters.
Students who have completed master's coursework are eligible only if no more than one semester has passed since completion.
Students on leave of absence are eligible.
An activity certificate and a certificate of completion will be issued only to those who complete the entire program (orientation, camp and connect session).
Awards will be given to outstanding participants.
steps: Read the detailed information on the SNU Grand Quest website (grandquest.snu.ac.kr).
Complete the application form and attach it in your individual application on the SNU Grand Quest website (grandquest.snu.ac.kr) by Thursday, 5 November 2026.
Wait for individual contact about the selection result during the second week of November.
If selected, attend the orientation on 16 December 2026, the camp from 6 to 8 January 2027, and the connect session on 24 March 2027 to complete the whole program.
For questions, use the official program email address given in the original notice.
translation:
Recruitment for the 2027 Junior Program of the SNU Grand Quest Academy

In connection with the 'SNU Grand Quest' initiative promoted by the University, the 2027 Junior Program of the SNU Grand Quest Academy, aimed at the next generation of scholars, will be held as follows.

A. Program name: SNU Grand Quest Academy Junior
※ What is the SNU Grand Quest Academy?
- An on-campus program that supports the next generation of scholars in a thinking process of exploring questions from various perspectives and expanding and developing them.
- Within it, the '2027 Junior Program' is for undergraduate and master's students and aims to help them learn how to structure and reinterpret questions.

B. Eligibility and number of participants: undergraduate students and master's students; about 25 will be selected.
- Includes students on leave of absence and students in the integrated master's-doctoral program (석박통합과정) within their first four semesters.
- Includes students who have completed master's coursework (수료), provided they are within one semester after completion.

C. Main schedule and content
- Starting from a single question, participants form teams with peers from other majors and perspectives and repeatedly develop it into new questions, thereby learning how to ask questions.

Orientation (1 day) ▶ Camp (3 days, 2 nights) ▶ Connect (1 day)
- Orientation: preliminary exploration, Wednesday, 16 December 2026
- Camp: question inquiry, Wednesday, 6 January to Friday, 8 January 2027
- Connect: presentation of results, Wednesday, 24 March 2027

- An activity certificate and a certificate of completion will be issued upon completion of the entire program.
- Awards will be given to outstanding participants.

D. How and when to apply
- Application period: until Thursday, 5 November 2026
- How to apply: apply individually on the SNU Grand Quest website (grandquest.snu.ac.kr); complete the application form and attach it.
- Selection results: applicants will be contacted individually during the second week of November.

E. Detailed information: SNU Grand Quest website

F. Inquiries: the program's official email address (given in the original notice).
